author: GamingBolt
description:
Having gone through the dramatic events that unfold in Raccoon City, eventually ending in its complete destruction, our Resident Evil recap is ready to move into the franchise’s next phase- because let’s face it, it was with Resident Evil: Code – Veronica that the franchise really started leaning hard into the corniness that it became increasingly synonymous with. 

So here in part 8 of our Resident Evil recap, then, we’re going to talk about the outlandish events of Code Veronica. 

Before we get into the events of the game proper, however, we’re going to have to do something we often do with our Resident Evil recaps- pause, wind the clock back, and drop some crucial backstory.
title: Resident Evil Code Veronica FULL STORY EXPLAINED - Part 8 - Before You Play Resident Evil Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
There's a lot about Nioh 3 that the game doesn't really tell you about, the franchise's refusal to hold its player's hands being quite evident in the way you're let loose in this kingdom right after that explosive prologue. 

But that's where we come in! We've dived into the open-world and managed to remain standing long enough to put together a few useful tips for you to keep in mind as you reach for the Shogunate across time and space. 

From managing your play styles to the right stats and strategies you need to ensure your survival, you're going to want to give this one a watch before you get started. This isn't an easy game, but it does get easier if you know what to do, after all.
title: Nioh 3 - 15 Things It DOESN'T Tell You

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's a great day for many reasons, but perhaps none more so than seeing Crimson Desert's second part of its Features Overview series. The first one focuses on the story and exploration – who are the Greymanes, how they end up separated, what is Kliff's purpose and so on. 

This one is a lot more straightforward, focusing on combat and progression. We've seen glimpses of the former over the past couple of years, whether it's Kliff RKO-ing fools out of nowhere or heaving them into the abyss (and we don't mean the one in the sky). But what else do you need to know about taking the fight to your enemies? Let's dive in, starting with my personal favorite...
title: Crimson Desert - 15 NEW Details You Need To Know Before You PRE-ORDER
